_meta.description: Shell plc year-by-year financials. Revenue and net income are IFRS figures (net income = income attributable to Shell plc shareholders). Capex = cash capital expenditure. Production = total available for sale, thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day (kboe/d).
_meta.note: The company was 'Royal Dutch Shell plc' through 2021 and 'Shell plc' from January 2022. 2020 was a loss year driven by the COVID demand collapse and large impairments. 2022 was a record-profit year.

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.desc: Total money taken in from selling energy and products — the top line, before any costs.

metrics.label: Net income
metrics.desc: Profit (or loss) left for shareholders after all costs and taxes — the bottom line.

metrics.label: Capital expenditure
metrics.desc: Cash invested in building and maintaining assets like platforms, plants and projects.

metrics.label: Oil & gas production
